subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should OpenClaw continue with this PR's optional `currentAttemptReplayMetadata` result contract and `server_error` retry-before-failover behavior after the compaction side-effect gap is fixed?
rationale: The code direction addresses a real P1 bug, but it changes retry, session-state, message-delivery, and harness-result semantics, and several competing PRs are open for the same canonical issue.

options.title: Fix this branch, then reconsider
options.body: Require the compaction side-effect fix, conflict resolution, and real runner or gateway proof before accepting this branch as the canonical fix.

options.title: Pick another candidate branch
options.body: Use a different open candidate for the canonical issue if maintainers prefer its patch shape or proof trail, preserving only useful tests or evidence from this PR.

options.title: Reject the new result field
options.body: Ask for a different same-attempt side-effect signal if maintainers do not want to extend the embedded attempt result contract.

recommendation.title: Fix this branch, then reconsider
recommendation.body: Require the compaction side-effect fix, conflict resolution, and real runner or gateway proof before accepting this branch as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to the recent retry, terminal-state, and harness-adjacent history across the affected files.
